n: Actua 20 Questions: An Unplugged AI Adventure
t: A one-hour unplugged activity that builds a decision tree to classify Arctic animals.
steps: Find the Actua 20 Questions write-up and download it.
Download the slide deck and the animal card set.
Print the cards and gather dice, chart paper, and markers.
Set up a laptop, a projector, and speakers.
Run the Rock, Paper, Decisions game for about 15 minutes.
Run the 20 Questions decision tree for about 30 minutes.
End with a five minute reflection and debrief.
